title: www.retailinmotion.com
description: Retail InMotion specializes in onboard retail solutions for airlines, utilizing their proprietary Vector technology to enhance the retail experience for both crew and passengers. Their services encompass the entire retail lifecycle, including stock management, in-flight ordering, payment processing, and data analytics. With over 20 years of experience, they partner with leading global airlines to optimize ancillary revenue and improve operational efficiency. Retail InMotion is committed to delivering secure, reliable, and innovative solutions tailored to the unique needs of the aviation industry.
